intel.title: [CISA KEV] Linux Kernel - Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2025-39964
廠商: Linux
產品: Kernel
漏洞名稱: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
說明: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: ; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/0f28c4adbc4a97437874c9b669fd7958a8c6d6ce; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/e4c1ec11132ec466f7362a95f36a506ce4dc08c9; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/1f323a48e9b5ebfe6dc7d130fdf5c3c0e92a07c8; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/7c4491b5644e3a3708f3dbd7591be0a570135b84; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/9aee87da5572b3a14075f501752e209801160d3d; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/45bcf60fe49b37daab1acee57b27211ad1574042; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/1b34cbbf4f011a121ef7b2d7d6e6920a036d5285 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-39964

analysis.summary: 此情資指出 Linux 核心存在競爭條件漏洞（CVE-2025-39964），攻擊者可透過並行寫入 AF_ALG 套接字導致內部狀態不一致。該漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 且有活躍攻擊風險，由於公司資產清冊中包含 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器，因此存在直接受影響的風險。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 系統管理部門（RR40）應立即盤點並針對「資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Linux ubuntu」進行核心（Kernel）版本檢查。 2. 依據 Linux 官方及 Ubuntu 安全公告，儘速將核心升級至已修補之安全版本（參考相關 Git commit 修正案）。 3. 在修補完成前，嚴格限制伺服器的本地存取權限，以防範潛在的本地權限提升攻擊。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Linux Kernel - Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-53266
廠商: Linux
產品: Kernel
漏洞名稱: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
說明: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: ; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/bf84ad7c7a9ede46e31afaa41a1ba06a159e8c87; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/76280b78cc9f23bdc6438e10ad6dff148ef8375b; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/b7e91939ba9be805a62a257fa4e227dffbb88fa0; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/afd64b59c3de9bbbdd3759e834fdc55cda716e0b; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/153ea96c806aea395daba907a4f88480b6ad5093; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/b18675263db1147c8e1cab625400c13a0d87bd2d; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/c9b5ff59feffb92a147a84a5aa28acd2cb8ff4c5; https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/67ba971ae02514d85818fe0c32549ab4bfa3bf49 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53266

analysis.summary: 此情資指出 Linux Kernel 的 ebtables SNAT 元件存在帶外寫入漏洞（CVE-2026-53266），已被收錄於 CISA KEV 且存在活躍的在野攻擊。攻擊者可藉此漏洞寫入特定通訊端緩衝區，進而導致系統權限提升或執行任意程式碼。由於公司資產清冊中包含 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器，面臨直接的安全威脅，需儘速進行核心修補。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 針對受影響的 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器，應立即執行系統更新並將 Linux Kernel 升級至已修補之安全版本（參考 Linux 官方釋出之穩定核心版本，或套用對應之 upstream commit bf84ad7c7a9ede46e31afaa41a1ba06a159e8c87 等安全補丁）。2. 更新完成後需安排伺服器重啟以啟用新核心。3. 在完成更新前，建議檢視並限制 ebtables SNAT 相關網路規則之使用，以降低被利用之風險。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Linux Kernel - Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2025-39682
廠商: Linux
產品: Kernel
漏洞名稱: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
說明: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Linux Kernel 的 TLS 接收路徑存在安全漏洞（CVE-2025-39682），已被列入 CISA KEV 證實存在活躍威脅。該漏洞源於對零長度記錄的檢查不當，可能導致後續 TLS 數據處理出錯。由於公司資產中包含 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器，面臨直接受攻擊風險。
analysis.recommendation: 請系統管理員立即針對公司內部的 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器執行套件更新，將 Linux Kernel 升級至已修補 CVE-2025-39682 的最新安全版本（參考 Ubuntu 官方安全公告），並於更新後重啟伺服器以套用新核心。
